newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Taiyo Oil to build 88,000 dwt oil tanker.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Taiyo Oil to build 88,000 dwt oil tanker.

text.p: Japanese oil refiner Taiyo Oil Co Ltd will build an 88,000 deadweight tonne (dwt) oil tanker, named Dai-san Taiyo Maru, at an estimated cost of about 4.5 billion yen, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
The ship, which will be Taiyo's third oil tanker, is to be used to transport crude from Southeast Asia, the source of some 70 percent of the company's crude oil.

The company hopes to save on freight costs by operating the tanker, which is due to be launched next May. The oil company's remaining crude oil needs are covered through spot purchases of Middle Eastern crudes, the spokesman said.
